newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telebras up on tariff outlook.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telebras up on tariff outlook.

text.p: Telebras American depositary receipts extended their 1997 rally Monday with a 3-1/4 leap to an all-time high 106-3/8 on market murmurs that the Brazilian telephone company's new tariffs to be unveiled next month could represent increases of up to 30 percent, traders said.
"It is momentum that contines to go unabated, helped by a couple of things today regarding earnings and the tariff hikes," said a New York-based ADR trader.
"The tariff outlook has been swarming around the market for weeks, but over the weekend there were reports that the hikes could be about 25 to 30 percent," he said.

"The tariff and earnings expectations were already in the market, but now they are higher than previously expected. It is driving Brazilian stocks and Latin American telecommunication issues," he said.
Since the beginning of the year, Telebras ADRs have risen from around 75.
Telefonos de Mexico ADRs also rose, adding 3/8 to 39-3/4.
The ADR market was generally firmer, with a group of 806 issues showing 297 gainers, 211 decliners and 298 unchanged.
Of that group, News Corp preferred shares was most active, rising 1/8 to 18.
Elsewhere, Corel ADRs added 3/8 to 6-5/8, Creative Technologies fell 1-7/16 to 10-1/4.
